name: Zhizi yu Jingji
source:
Ordinary girl Chen Zhizi is scouted by an entertainment company. Thinking it's luck, she soon finds her talented teammates have complicated pasts. Can she help them debut? Or just become someone's "prey"? In this game, follow her view on a surprising journey. Your choices shape the comedy's ending.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4855530/Bloom_among_thorns/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
平凡女孩陈智子被娱乐公司看中。她认为这是运气，但很快发现她才华横溢的队友有着复杂的过去。她能帮助他们出道吗？或者只是成为某人的“猎物”？在这款游戏中，跟随她的观点踏上一段令人惊奇的旅程。你的选择决定了喜剧的结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4855530/Bloom_among_thorns/]Steam[/url]]
